cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

mechanism: Copy a dog owner's evening routine without understanding its medical purpose, then restrict a dog-sitting promise to the exact word today when overnight care is proposed.
confusable: Not simple lack of affection: A must repeat the agreed time word and use B's practical workaround to narrow only its obligation, while covering the copied routine.
comparison: Pet-care time boundary and a delayed return rather than quantity of moving work.
seedUse: Retains watch-dog-today versus calendar extension/love; adds copied food-bowl removal before medicine.
